title: pi's streamed workers-ai calls leave no gateway log row
description:
The AI Gateway writes a log row only when the client drains the response stream. Verified live: curl aborted mid-stream logs nothing, and two successful pi runs through the gateway override (exit 0, correct answer, tagged) left no row even minutes later, while a streamed curl to the same route logged instantly. pi stops consuming after finish_reason, so the usage and DONE chunks go unread. The dm2 join routes and tags correctly, but real local pi dispatches will not surface as metered rows until the stream is drained — e.g. by the generated extension registering a complete provider whose stream drains the response, or an upstream pi fix. Without this, A4's metered half stays honest but empty for pi-streamed calls.
evidence: live, 2026-10-05T18:09-18:12Z: gateway logs query for run_id dm2-probe2/dm2-probe3 shows only the FAIL rows and my curl rows, none for pi's two exit-0 runs; the aborted-stream control is curl --max-time 3, no row for dm2-abort
